selected_experiment.reason: CP-006 checkpoint replacement improved aggregate metrics but did not reduce false contradictions or improve DA-017. The existing optional adapter hook limits deployment and rollback blast radius while allowing targeted multilingual/domain learning.

readiness_gaps_that_block_training: No Phase 2B corpus, train/dev manifest, review ledger, or frozen corpus hash exists.
The configured legacy pilot files are absent and are not authorized substitutes for the new corpus.
The current config excludes DS-014 only; it does not yet encode all ten CP-005 protected question IDs or premise/hypothesis/pair exclusion.
The current training loader accepts legacy pair shapes and does not enforce the Phase 2B required fields or semantic-family review gate.
The current training model loader uses a mutable model ID without an immutable revision or snapshot hash assertion.
The current training tokenization defaults to max_length=128 rather than the proposed pinned 256 contract.
No focused LoRA training/preflight test file exists in the current test inventory.
No Phase 2B output directory or adapter checkpoint exists.
required_command_flow_if_later_authorize: Create and independently review the 600-case corpus from non-protected source questions.
Run the CP-005 exclusion policy against inline train/dev records and fail closed on any overlap or provenance defect.
Freeze corpus, split, source-corpus, exclusion-policy, tokenizer, model, and one-config hashes before model initialization.
Run focused preflight and tiny synthetic smoke tests; do not load the real base model if any gate fails.
Invoke one hardened run_nli_finetune flow with the pinned baseline revision and the frozen Phase 2B manifest.
Persist adapter/trainer artifacts and hashes, then evaluate internal dev once.
After configuration freeze, run one CP-005 adapter A/B plus the separate Coverage/scoring regression gate.
Do not promote; issue a measurement checkpoint and request separate production authorization.

predeclared_acceptance.decision_limit: Passing permits an engineering recommendation only; production promotion remains separately authorized.

rollback_strategy.experiment: Retain the adapter artifact but omit adapter_path and reload the pinned base model; no production state is changed during the experiment.
rollback_strategy.future_promotion_if_ever_authorized: Remove the adapter-path reference, restart the NLI process on the pinned base revision, and require exact CP-005 baseline parity before closure.

exact_next_step_if_authorized: Phase 2B Data Authoring: create and independently review the 600-case train/dev corpus from at least 40 non-protected question IDs, then run the CP-005 exclusion and corpus-quality preflight. Stop before model loading or training and request separate training authorization.
